## Before you write it

Please check [the roadmap](../../docs/roadmap.md) — particularly the section on
what we've **decided not to build**. Some good ideas are turned down on purpose:

- Any match score, ATS score, résumé grade or percentage. Nobody outside an ATS
  vendor knows how one reads a résumé, so the number would be invented.
- Auto-apply, or anything that sends on your behalf. hunt drafts; a human presses
  send.
- Anything that writes experience you don't have.

If your request touches one of those, it's still worth opening — but say how it
could work without hunt asserting something it hasn't checked, because that's
the constraint the answer has to fit.
